args.title: Trim carriage returns in parseStatement to support Windows line endings
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim carriage returns (`\r`) when parsing statement lines in `parseStatement` to correctly handle files with Windows line endings (`\r\n`) and prevent spurious `Malformed row` errors.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseStatement splits input by "\n", leaving a trailing "\r" on lines from Windows-formatted files which causes a Malformed row error.
